scientific_integrity: Exact geometric proof and cited homotopy recurrence; finite numerical checks explicitly bounded. No claim of external certification or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the penultimate Euclidean Rips stage and its exact disappearance are classified, not the earlier filtration or its maps. Cycle independence-complex homotopy types are credited as known; independently reproduced finite calculations support but do not prove the infinite claim. An equivalent unindexed statement remains possible.
title: A parity and mod-three law for the penultimate Euclidean Vietoris–Rips complexes of regular antiprisms
